The number of securities approved by security holders but not yet issued as of May 31 2014 was 8,945,694 shares.  
Using the weighted‑average exercise price of $40.85 per share, the total value is:

\[
8{,}945{,}694 \times 40.85 \approx 365{,}431{,}590.9
\]

Rounded to two decimals, the total value is **$365.43 million**. [D43_C1]
